text:
jess marshall: Ok team — kicking off co-marketing with Catalyst (cloud marketplace). Goals: 500 webinar regs, 75 demos (MQL), and 20 SQLs in first 90 days. Need plan across launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar, and inbound routing. Thoughts? :tada:

leo gonzalez: love it. first quick Q — are we doing a co-branded landing page or just Catalyst listing + our blog post?

samir patel: co-branded LP please. easier to control messaging and capture UTM. also we should push a short benchmark that compares Redwood inference latency/cost vs baseline on Catalyst infra — helps the marketplace listing + PR.

emily cho: agree on LP. I'll own creative + copy for LP and blog. deadline: need final assets in 10 business days to hit webinar promo cadence.

alex wang: I'll pull a tight benchmark matrix with perf numbers (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens) and a short methods section. Can we get access to Catalyst test VMs by EOW?

catalyst-marketing (partner): we can provision a sandbox cluster. tagging @alex wang — I'll DM infra access details. We prefer to promote joint webinar vs press for first push.

jess marshall: Good. Webinar + blog + marketplace listing. Ops items: registration form, replay workflow, lead routing to SFDC. Who owns lead mapping?

leo gonzalez: I can own SFDC mapping with ops. Proposal: inbound leads from LP/webinar -> HubSpot form -> SFDC lead with fields: source=marketplace, partner=catalyst, campaign=cat-launch-2026. Add `lead_source=CatalystMarketplace` and UTM auto mapping.

samir patel: Also add a hidden field `partner_tier=co-marketing` for segmentation. For routing, if lead_score >= 60 -> AE queue, else -> nurture. We'll use `lead_owner_rule` = round_robin(team:cloudAEs).

emily cho: Assets checklist for me: logos (svg/png), 2 screenshots (dashboard + latency graph), 1 short video (1min), speaker bios, short teaser copy (3 variants).

alex wang: Bench draft will include a table + one chart. Example snippet for LP copy: `Using Redwood + Catalyst we observed 2.3x throughput at 30% lower per-token cost vs baseline` (will verify numbers).

catalyst-marketing (partner): For webinar logistics we can provide a Catalyst product lead and a solutions engineer. Prefer Wed or Thu afternoons PST. Also we'll run partner email to our marketplace list (approx 30k).

jess marshall: Webinar date target: Thu May 12 10am PT (tentative). Emily, lock that if you can. Leo/Samir, draft the lead flow spec and SFDC mapping by EOD Friday so ops-bot can validate triggers.

ops-bot: reminder: please submit JIRA ticket for inbound routing by 1812345725 or webhook validations will be delayed.

leo gonzalez: Will do the SFDC mapping doc now — will post link here. Also adding UTM scheme: `utm_source=catalyst`, `utm_medium=marketplace`, `utm_campaign=cat-launch-2026`.

samir patel: Quick note on messaging: keep benchmark narrative focused on production economics (latency, cost, reliability) not raw accuracy. That's our sweet spot.

emily cho: Draft promo calendar: Week -3: partner teaser social + marketplace highlight. Week -2: blog + LP live + email to partner list. Week -1: webinar reminder cadence (3 touches). Day 0: webinar + replay email. Post: nurture flow + request demo CTA.

jess marshall: Metrics to track: regs, attended, replay views, demo requests, SQL conversions, CAC estimate. Target KPIs: 15% attend rate, 15% demo request from attendees, 25% conversion to MQL from demo requests.

alex wang: I'll include a reproducibility appendix with commands for our benchmark so Catalyst can reproduce on their infra. Eg: `./run_bench --model redwood-xl --sequence 1024 --batch 8 --quantize q4`.

catalyst-marketing (partner): we'll need logos and legal-approved co-marketing text 5 business days before announcement. Also confirm whether the blog post needs any partner review cycles.

samir patel: Partner review = 48 hours for blog text; 72 hours for LP copy. Let's bake that into schedule.

emily cho: noted. I'll aim to get copy to Catalyst by Tue next week.

jess marshall: Owners recap: Emily = LP + blog + promo calendar; Alex = bench + reproducibility commands; Leo = SFDC mapping + UTM; Samir = lead routing rules + QA; Catalyst = sandbox + partner comms. Deadline: assets & mapping by Friday EOD. I'll run a final sync Fri 9am PT. :thumbsup:

leo gonzalez: tagging next steps in JIRA: ML-2453 (bench), MKT-3321 (LP), OPS-1984 (lead routing).

emily cho: putting speaker list and draft copy in the doc now: https://redwood.work/drive/cat-launch-draft (preview link)

catalyst-marketing (partner): thanks all — excited to get this live. We'll share our promo windows once dates confirmed. :rocket:

jess marshall: Great. If nothing else, we'll meet Fri 9am PT. Thanks everyone.
